title: Bias-Aware Agent: Enhancing Fairness in AI-Driven Knowledge Retrieval
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a technical framework for detecting and analyzing media bias in information retrieval systems to promote 'Responsible AI' and fairness. While the evaluation queries include topics such as abortion and Christian leaders, the work is centered on the detection of news bias and technical fairness metrics rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems themselves.
